skills.name: mekong-river-cruise-site
skills.description: Use when a traveler compares luxury or boutique Mekong River cruise ships in Vietnam, Cambodia, or Laos, checks 3/4/7-night USD cabin tariffs, asks about Tonle Sap water levels or onboard elevators, or wants a pre-filled quote or free 24-hour specialist itinerary check. Do not use for ocean mega-ships, budget backpacker ferries, flight-only bookings, or river cruises outside Southeast Asia.
